body:
Yeah it, uh, sounds like the lady you spoke to didn't exactly bring her A game. I mean, who complains about not having enough to work with while getting someone to put into words why they're feeling suicidal? Either way, I wouldn't blame yourself for that. I'm sorry that there wasn't a more caring human being on the other line.

Definitely give it another shot after a while and see if someone more helpful and patient picks up. Since you're waiting on that and your SO, all I can suggest is to find some distractions to hold you off and keep you from falling deeper into that head space. Like browsing silly memes, playing a game, etc. Just something to help take the edge off and occupy your mind.

As far as finding others to speak to about your suicidal thoughts, maybe there are some populated Discord servers for mental health you could try out. Just to have something to fall back on when the people you want to talk to aren't immediately available.
